---
title: "Daily Translation: Leaving a Phone at the Office"
author: "Ryan Sun"
date: "2026-10-06"
categories: [English Learning, Daily Translation]
---

## 中文原文
今天午休，我打算下楼超市买点水果。排队结账时，我忽然想起手机落在办公室了。我犹豫了一下，怕不及时拿回来会错过重要消息。于是我放下挑选好的水果，快步跑回办公室拿手机。等我再回到超市，午休时间已经所剩无几。

## My translation
During today's lunch break, I planned to buy some fruits at the supermarket downstairs.
When I was waiting in the checkout line, I suddenly realized I'd forgotten my phone at the office.
I hesitated for a moment, worrying that I might miss important messages if I didn't bring it back.
So I put the fruits back and hurried to the office to get my phone.
When I went back to the supermarket, the lunch break was nearly coming to an end.

## Revised version
During today's lunch break, I planned to buy some fruit at the supermarket downstairs.
While waiting in the checkout line, I suddenly realized I'd left my phone in the office.
I hesitated for a moment, worried that I might miss important messages without it.
So I put the fruit back and hurried to the office to get my phone.
By the time I returned to the supermarket, the lunch break was nearly over.

## Key phrases
- fruit泛指水果时不可数，fruits指多种不同品类水果
- leave sth. 某地, 把东西落在哪里了，不能用forget
- by the time，当...的时候
